abilities.full_description: Chiaotzu learned the Dodon Ray from the Crane School, though his version is weaker than Tien's. By focusing ki to his forehead, he fires a thin, pink energy beam at opponents. The technique is fast and precise but lacks the power of other energy attacks. He used it during the 22nd Tournament and against various enemies, though it's rarely effective against major villains. Still, it shows his dedication to martial arts despite his physical limitations.

abilities.name: Self-Destruct
abilities.short_description: Chiaotzu can sacrifice himself by exploding with all his energy, a technique he used against Nappa.
abilities.full_description: During the Saiyan invasion, Chiaotzu attempted to sacrifice himself to destroy Nappa. By wrapping his arms around Nappa and detonating all his ki, he created a massive explosion that he hoped would kill the stronger Saiyan. Unfortunately, the power difference was too great—Nappa survived with minimal damage while Chiaotzu died. He was later revived by the Dragon Balls. This selfless act demonstrated his courage and loyalty to Tien and his friends, despite knowing he was outmatched.

head.eyes: Large, determined blue eyes that reflect her strong will and fiery personality. They show confidence, curiosity, and later, deep love for Gohan. In battle, they narrow with focus and competitive spirit.
head.nose: Small and delicate, similar to her father Hercule's but more refined.
head.ears: Normal human ears, with small earrings in some appearances.
head.extra_facial_features: Long black hair worn in a ponytail with bangs in her initial appearance. After marrying Gohan, she cuts it shorter, more practical for motherhood. She has a beautiful, strong face with high cheekbones. Her expression is usually confident or determined, rarely showing fear. She has no visible scars, though she took quite a beating during the Buu saga.

body.chest: Athletic and fit (36 inches) with a toned, muscular build from years of martial arts training. She's strong for a human, with defined abs and a fit figure.
body.arms: Toned arms (13 inches) with visible muscle definition. Her hands are strong from training and fighting crime.

lower_body.legs: Strong, athletic legs (22 inches) built for martial arts and crime-fighting. She's agile and quick, with good jumping ability.

armor_costume.head: Initially: a white bandana or headband to keep her hair back. Later: no headgear, showing her shorter hair.

armor_costume.torso: Initially: a blue tank top with black shorts, or a school uniform as a high school student. As the Great Saiyaman's partner, she wears a modified version of his costume—a black bodysuit with gold accents, a red cape, and a helmet. In Dragon Ball Super, she wears casual clothes—t-shirts, jackets, comfortable pants.

armor_costume.arms: Bare arms showing her toned muscles. Sometimes wears gloves as a crime fighter.

armor_costume.legs: Black shorts or pants with boots. Practical clothing for fighting.

armor_costume.accessories: As a crime fighter, she wears a helmet similar to the Great Saiyaman's. She also carries a communication device. After marrying Gohan, she wears a wedding ring. She also has a capsule case.

abilities.name: Martial Arts
abilities.short_description: Videl is a skilled martial artist trained by her father Hercule, capable of competing at high levels despite lacking ki abilities.
abilities.full_description: Videl learned martial arts from her father, the World Martial Arts Champion (though his skills are exaggerated). She's an excellent fighter by human standards, skilled in striking, grappling, and acrobatics. She reached the finals of the 25th World Martial Arts Tournament, defeating opponents easily until facing Spopovich. Her skills allowed her to fight crime in Satan City as a vigilante before meeting Gohan. She's tough, determined, and doesn't back down from fights, even against much stronger opponents.

abilities.name: Flight
abilities.short_description: Videl learned to fly from Gohan, becoming one of the few Earthlings capable of unassisted flight.
abilities.full_description: Gohan taught Videl how to control her ki and fly, a skill rare among Earthlings. She learned remarkably quickly, demonstrating natural talent for ki manipulation. Though her power level is low compared to the Z Fighters, she can fly competently and use basic ki control. This skill was crucial during the Buu saga, allowing her to escape danger and participate in the battle (though she was quickly outmatched). Her ability to learn ki techniques so quickly impressed Gohan and showed her potential.

abilities.name: Determination
abilities.short_description: Videl's incredible willpower and refusal to give up, even against impossible odds, defines her character.
abilities.full_description: Videl's greatest strength is her indomitable spirit. During her match with Spopovich (who was empowered by Babidi), she refused to stay down despite horrific injuries—broken bones, severe bleeding, and overwhelming pain. She continued fighting long after any normal person would have collapsed, driven by pure determination. This same spirit led her to chase after Gohan during the Buu crisis and to support her family through everything. Her courage inspires those around her, including the much stronger Z Fighters.

head.eyes: Large, cat-like yellow eyes with slit pupils that reflect his divine nature and playful cruelty. They narrow with amusement or widen with genuine surprise. When angry, they become terrifyingly intense. They show ancient wisdom, childish whimsy, and destructive power all at once.
head.nose: Small, cat-like nose, fitting his feline appearance. Pink and slightly upturned.
head.ears: Large, pointed cat ears on the sides of his head, highly sensitive and twitching at sounds.
head.extra_facial_features: Purple skin with a feline appearance—he looks like an anthropomorphic Egyptian cat god. He has a slender, elegant face with pronounced cheekbones. His expression is usually bored or amused, rarely serious. He has long, droopy whiskers on his cheeks. His mouth often curls into a lazy smirk.

body.chest: Lean and elegant (42 inches) with a slender, feline build. Despite his slim appearance, he possesses universe-level destructive power. His chest is smooth purple skin with no visible muscle definition, but his power is immense.
body.arms: Long, slender arms (variable) that end in sharp claws. His hands are deceptively delicate but can destroy planets with a touch.

lower_body.legs: Long, feline legs with digitigrade structure, ending in clawed feet. He moves with cat-like grace and speed.

armor_costume.head: No headgear. His cat ears and whiskers are natural. He wears Egyptian-style eye makeup—thick black lines extending from his eyes.

armor_costume.torso: Traditional Egyptian-style god robes: a white and gold outfit with a decorative chest piece, shoulder guards, and a long skirt-like garment. The outfit is elegant and divine, befitting his station. He also wears a large, decorative belt with a sun-like symbol.

armor_costume.arms: His arms are bare except for golden bracelets or armlets on his upper arms and wrists. His claws are natural.

armor_costume.legs: His legs are partially covered by his skirt-like garment. He wears golden anklets.

armor_costume.accessories: He carries a staff of office, though rarely uses it. He's almost always accompanied by his angel attendant Whis. He also has a particular love for pudding and other gourmet foods, and his mood often depends on meal quality.

abilities.name: Destruction
abilities.short_description: As the God of Destruction, Beerus can destroy anything—from objects to planets to souls—with a touch or thought.
abilities.full_description: Beerus's primary divine ability: the power to erase anything from existence. Using a technique called Hakai, he can destroy matter at a fundamental level, leaving no trace behind. He can destroy planets with a gesture, erase souls permanently (preventing afterlife revival), and even destroy abstract concepts. The power is absolute—once destroyed by a God of Destruction, nothing can be restored, not even by Super Shenron (in most cases). He demonstrated this by destroying half a planet to make a point and threatening to destroy Earth over food.

abilities.name: Divine Combat
abilities.short_description: Beerus possesses godly combat abilities far beyond mortal comprehension, including Ultra Instinct at a mastered level.
abilities.full_description: Beerus has mastered combat over millions of years. He's one of the few beings who has fully mastered Ultra Instinct (though he chooses not to use it constantly), allowing his body to move and fight completely autonomously without thought. His speed, power, and skill far exceed anything mortal warriors can achieve. He defeated Super Saiyan 3 Goku with a single tap, fought evenly with Super Saiyan God Goku while using only a fraction of his power, and demonstrated techniques and abilities beyond mortal understanding. His combat experience spans eons, making him nearly unbeatable.

abilities.name: Divine Senses
abilities.short_description: Beerus can sense godly ki and events across the universe, and even detect when someone mentions his name.
abilities.full_description: As a god, Beerus possesses sensory abilities far beyond mortals. He can sense divine ki across vast distances, detect when someone speaks his name (a trait shared with gods in many mythologies), and perceive events happening throughout Universe 7. This is why he appeared on Earth when Goku and others discussed him. He can also sense the power levels of mortals with perfect accuracy and detect lies and deception. His senses are so refined that he can tell when someone is holding back or using techniques beyond normal perception.

characters.name: Whis
title: Angel of Universe 7
Son of the Grand Minister
Attendant to the God of Destruction
The One Who Trains Gods

head.eyes: Large, serene blue eyes that hold infinite wisdom and ancient knowledge. They are always calm, never showing surprise or fear. They reflect his angelic nature—peaceful yet powerful, watching all with patient amusement.
head.nose: Small and delicate, fitting his elegant features.
head.ears: Pointed, elf-like ears that mark his angelic heritage. Long and elegant.
head.extra_facial_features: Pale blue skin with an otherworldly glow. Long, flowing white hair styled in an elaborate, gravity-defying arrangement with a large curl at the front. He has a slender, androgynous face with high cheekbones and full lips. His expression is perpetually calm and slightly amused. He wears a gem on his forehead—a large blue oval that matches his eyes. Around his neck is a distinctive white ring (angel halo).

body.chest: Tall, slender, and elegant (variable) with an androgynous build. His body appears almost ethereal, with no visible muscle definition despite his infinite power.
body.arms: Long, graceful arms that end in delicate hands. He holds his angel staff constantly.

lower_body.legs: Long, elegant legs. As an angel, he floats rather than walks, his feet rarely touching the ground.

armor_costume.head: No headgear, but he wears a large blue gem on his forehead. His elaborate white hair is his most distinctive feature. He also wears the angel halo—a white ring floating behind his neck.

armor_costume.torso: Angelic robes: a form-fitting white and blue outfit with intricate patterns. The design is elegant and otherworldly, with a high collar and decorative elements. He wears a large blue gem on his chest matching his forehead gem.

armor_costume.arms: Long white sleeves cover his arms, with blue accents. His hands are usually visible, holding his staff.

armor_costume.legs: Long, flowing robes cover his legs. He floats, so his feet are rarely visible.

armor_costume.accessories: His angel staff—a long, ornate rod topped with a floating orb that glows with divine energy. The staff is both a symbol of office and a tool. He also carries a small bag of supplies, often including gourmet food for Beerus.

abilities.name: Angelic Powers
abilities.short_description: As an angel, Whis possesses powers far beyond gods of destruction, including mastery of Ultra Instinct and reality manipulation.
abilities.full_description: Angels are the highest beings in the Dragon Ball hierarchy, second only to the Omni-King. Whis has mastered Ultra Instinct completely (unlike Goku's imperfect version), allowing his body to fight autonomously with perfect efficiency. He can reverse time (up to three minutes), teleport across the universe instantly, heal wounds, and create pocket dimensions. His power is so far beyond Beerus that he can defeat the God of Destruction with a single finger tap while barely trying. Angels are forbidden from fighting unless in self-defense, but Whis's power is effectively infinite.

abilities.name: Time Rewind
abilities.short_description: Whis can reverse time by up to three minutes, allowing him to undo events and prevent catastrophes.
abilities.full_description: One of Whis's most useful abilities—he can rewind time by up to three minutes, effectively resetting events within that window. He used this during the fight with Frieza on Earth, rewinding time to save the planet from destruction. The ability has limits: he can only rewind three minutes, and he must be aware of the event to reverse it. He can also use it in training, allowing students to learn from mistakes by experiencing them multiple times. This ability makes him effectively unbeatable—he can simply undo any defeat.

abilities.name: Divine Training
abilities.short_description: Whis is an unparalleled martial arts teacher, having trained Beerus, Goku, and Vegeta to godly levels.
abilities.full_description: Whis serves as the martial arts instructor for his assigned God of Destruction and, more recently, for Goku and Vegeta. His training methods are unorthodox but incredibly effective—he teaches through experience, allowing students to learn by doing. He trained Beerus for millions of years, making him the powerful god he is today. In just a few years of part-time training, he elevated Goku and Vegeta to Super Saiyan Blue and Ultra Instinct levels. His teaching focuses on fundamentals, ki control, and most importantly, the principle of "moving without thinking" that leads to Ultra Instinct.

characters.name: Chi-Chi
title: Princess of Fire Mountain
Martial Artist
Mother of Gohan and Goten
The One Who Rules the Son Family

head.eyes: Large, expressive black eyes that flash with fiery determination when angered, but soften with love for her family. They can narrow into a terrifying glare that makes even Goku and Vegeta cower.
head.nose: Small and delicate, often wrinkled when she's angry or scolding someone.
head.ears: Normal human ears, often hidden by her hair. She has excellent hearing, especially when her sons are up to mischief.
head.extra_facial_features: Long, straight black hair worn in a traditional Chinese bun or ponytail, often with decorative hairpins. She has a beautiful, youthful face that has aged gracefully. Her expression is usually stern or worried, but occasionally soft and loving. In her youth, she wore a helmet with horns as the Ox Princess.

body.chest: Slim and athletic (37 inches) with a toned figure from her martial arts background. Not muscular, but fit and healthy.
body.arms: Slender arms (12 inches) with deceptively strong hands from years of housework and occasional combat. She can swing a frying pan with devastating accuracy.

lower_body.legs: Shapely legs (21 inches) that are quick and agile, though she rarely uses them for combat anymore. She can still kick when necessary.

armor_costume.head: In her youth: a traditional Chinese helmet with horns. As an adult: decorative hairpins or a simple headband. Sometimes wears a bandana when cleaning.

armor_costume.torso: Initially: a pink and white Chinese-style dress with a purple sash. Later: a pink blouse or dress with an apron over it, her iconic homemaker outfit. Sometimes wears a green training gi when forced to fight.

armor_costume.arms: Usually covered by sleeves. Her hands are often gloved when doing housework or holding her ever-present frying pan.

armor_costume.legs: Long skirt or practical pants. Comfortable shoes for chasing Goku and her sons.

armor_costume.accessories: Her signature frying pan—both a cooking tool and a weapon. She also carries a ladle, a rolling pin, and various kitchen utensils that double as disciplining tools. A wedding ring from Goku. Sometimes an umbrella.

abilities.name: Frying Pan Strike
abilities.short_description: Chi-Chi's signature attack, using her frying pan to deliver devastating blows to anyone who upsets her—especially Goku.
abilities.full_description: A seemingly simple but incredibly effective technique. Chi-Chi wields her cast-iron frying pan with the precision of a master martial artist, striking with enough force to dent metal and knock out even Super Saiyans. The attack is always unexpected and never misses its target when Chi-Chi is angry. It has been used to discipline Goku, Gohan, Goten, and even intimidated Vegeta. The psychological impact is as devastating as the physical blow.

abilities.name: Ox Princess Style
abilities.short_description: Chi-Chi learned martial arts from her father, the Ox King, and is a skilled fighter by human standards.
abilities.full_description: Before becoming a full-time mother, Chi-Chi was a capable martial artist. She trained under her father, the Ox King, and participated in the 23rd World Martial Arts Tournament, where she fought Goku (though she was more interested in marrying him). Her skills include basic strikes, kicks, and grappling. While far outclassed by Saiyans, she can still handle normal threats and has been known to throw Goku across the room when annoyed.

abilities.name: Intimidation
abilities.short_description: Chi-Chi's anger is so fearsome that it can terrify even the strongest warriors in the universe.
abilities.full_description: Chi-Chi possesses a unique ability to intimidate beings far more powerful than herself. When angered, her aura transforms into something primal and terrifying—even Beerus has shown discomfort when she yells at him about food. This ability stems from her role as a mother and wife, and her absolute authority in the Son household. It bypasses power levels entirely, affecting gods and mortals alike.

characters.name: Broly
title: Legendary Super Saiyan of Legend
Warrior from Planet Vegeta
The Saiyan Who Destroys Everything
The One Who Cannot Be Controlled

head.eyes: Piercing green eyes that glow with savage fury and madness. In his Legendary Super Saiyan form, they lose pupils and become completely white, radiating pure destructive instinct. When calm, they show deep sadness and confusion.
head.nose: Straight, well-defined nose, often flared in rage.
head.ears: Normal Saiyan ears, slightly pointed. He has a small earring-like device in his first appearance (a remote shock collar).
head.extra_facial_features: Long, wild black hair that reaches his waist in base form. When transformed into Legendary Super Saiyan, his hair turns golden-green, grows even longer, and stands on end with immense energy. He has a muscular, angular face with sharp features. A small scar above his right eye. His expression is usually a maniacal grin or a blank stare of rage. He wears a traditional Saiyan headband with metal plates (in his first movie appearance).

body.chest: Massively muscular (55 inches) with a physique far exceeding normal Saiyans. His chest is broad beyond measure, with pectorals that seem carved from stone. His entire body radiates power, with muscles so dense they appear armor-like.
body.arms: Colossal arms (20 inches) with bulging biceps and forearms that can crush planets. His hands are enormous, capable of gripping and tearing anything.

lower_body.legs: Tree-trunk-like legs (30 inches) that support his massive frame with explosive power. His thighs are immense, allowing him to move with terrifying speed despite his size.

armor_costume.head: Traditional Saiyan headband with metal plates and a small controller device (used by Paragus to control him). In his base form, his hair is tied back with a small band.

armor_costume.torso: Standard Saiyan battle armor: a dark blue bodysuit with white shoulder pauldrons and chest plate. The armor is often torn and stretched to its limits by his massive muscles. In the second coming, he wears torn pants and a chest harness.

armor_costume.arms: White gauntlets cover his forearms. His arms are otherwise bare, showing his incredible muscle definition.

armor_costume.legs: Matching dark blue Saiyan armor leggings with knee guards and white boots. Often damaged during his rampages.

armor_costume.accessories: The shock collar/controller on his head, used by Paragus to keep him in check. A small capsule containing his father (in some versions). He also wears a traditional Saiyan tail (though it's often hidden).

abilities.name: Legendary Super Saiyan Form
abilities.short_description: A unique transformation far beyond normal Super Saiyan, granting immense power, size increase, and uncontrollable rage.
abilities.full_description: Broly's legendary transformation is unique among Saiyans. When activated, his power increases exponentially—far beyond Super Saiyan 3 or even God forms in some continuities. His hair turns golden-green, his eyes lose their pupils, and his muscles swell to monstrous proportions. In this form, he gains an energy aura that destroys everything around him, can create massive energy spheres (Eraser Cannon/Gigantic Meteor), and becomes virtually unstoppable. The form also drives him berserk, making him attack friend and foe alike, with a particular obsession with killing Goku due to their shared infancy trauma.

abilities.name: Eraser Cannon
abilities.short_description: Broly's signature energy attack—a massive green energy sphere that can destroy entire planets and galaxies.
abilities.full_description: Broly charges an enormous sphere of green energy between his hands, then hurls it at his target. The attack's power is immense—in his first movie, he used a variant (Gigantic Meteor) that threatened to destroy the entire South Galaxy. The energy sphere tracks its target and detonates with catastrophic force. Even the name "Eraser Cannon" suggests it erases whatever it hits from existence. He can also create multiple spheres simultaneously.

abilities.name: Omega Blaster
abilities.short_description: A devastating continuous energy blast fired from Broly's hands, sweeping across the battlefield.
abilities.full_description: Broly extends his hands and unleashes a massive, continuous beam of green energy that he can sweep across entire landscapes. The Omega Blaster was used to destroy everything in his path during his rampage on Earth. The beam's width and power are immense, capable of leveling mountains and carving canyons. It requires enormous energy, but Broly's legendary form provides more than enough.

characters.name: King Kai
title: Kai of the North Galaxy
Teacher of the Spirit Bomb and Kaioken
Guardian of the Serpent Road
The One Who Trained Goku

head.eyes: Small, cheerful black eyes that twinkle with mischief and wisdom. They often squint in amusement or widen in surprise at his students' antics.
head.nose: Small and round, fitting his short, pudgy face.
head.ears: Small, hidden by his white hair. He has antennae on his head—two small, black protrusions that are his Kai sensory organs.
head.extra_facial_features: Blue skin characteristic of Kais. White hair that forms a halo-like ring around his head, with a small bald patch on top. He wears a pair of sunglasses constantly, even indoors. He has a round, jolly face with a perpetual smile or amused grin. He also has a white mustache and small goatee. A small halo floats above his head, as he is deceased.

body.chest: Short and round (40 inches) with a potbelly. His body is not built for combat, though he is quite strong for a Kai.
body.arms: Short, pudgy arms (14 inches) that are surprisingly strong from his years of training and his daily exercises with weights and his car.

lower_body.legs: Short, stout legs (20 inches) that allow him to move around his tiny planet with ease. He can jump surprisingly high when motivated.

armor_costume.head: No headgear besides his sunglasses. His halo floats behind his head. His antennae are natural.

armor_costume.torso: Traditional Kai attire: a dark blue or black outfit with a white cape and high collar. The outfit has the symbol of the Kais on the chest. He also wears a red sash around his waist.

armor_costume.arms: Long sleeves cover his arms, with simple cuffs. His hands are bare.

armor_costume.legs: Matching dark pants with simple boots.

armor_costume.accessories: His most prized possession: a small, vintage car that he drives around his tiny planet (which is only large enough for a house, a car, and some trees). He also has a monkey named Bubbles who helps with training. He carries a staff of office on occasion.

abilities.name: Kaioken
abilities.short_description: A technique King Kai developed that multiplies the user's power temporarily by focusing ki in a dangerous burst.
abilities.full_description: The Kaioken is King Kai's signature technique, taught to Goku during his training on King Kai's planet. By focusing ki and pushing beyond normal limits, the user can multiply their power by a factor (Kaioken x2, x3, etc.) for a short time. However, the technique places immense strain on the body—using too high a multiplier can cause severe damage or death. King Kai developed this technique to allow fighters to briefly exceed their limits, and it remains one of the most versatile techniques in the Dragon Ball universe, later combined with Super Saiyan Blue by Goku.

abilities.name: Spirit Bomb
abilities.short_description: A technique that gathers energy from all living things and the environment to create a massive energy sphere.
abilities.full_description: King Kai taught Goku the Spirit Bomb, a technique that draws upon the life energy of all living beings, as well as the energy of the planet and atmosphere. The user must remain still and concentrate while gathering energy, making it difficult to use in combat. However, the resulting sphere is immensely powerful—capable of destroying evil beings beyond normal means. Goku used it to defeat Frieza, Kid Buu, and other villains. The technique requires a pure heart to use effectively, as evil intentions prevent gathering energy.

abilities.name: Telepathy
abilities.short_description: King Kai can communicate telepathically with anyone across vast distances, even between planets and the afterlife.
abilities.full_description: As a Kai, King Kai possesses powerful telepathic abilities. He can communicate with anyone in the universe, regardless of distance, and can even transmit thoughts across the boundary between the living world and the afterlife. He used this ability constantly to coach Goku during battles on Namey and Earth, and to coordinate the Z Fighters. He can also sense ki and events across his assigned quadrant of the universe.

characters.name: Bardock
title: Low-Class Saiyan Warrior
Leader of Team Bardock
The First to Know Frieza's Betrayal
The One Who Saw the Future

head.eyes: Sharp, determined black eyes that reflect his warrior spirit and rebellious nature. They show cunning, experience, and a fierce love for his comrades. In his final moments, they blazed with defiance.
head.nose: Straight, well-defined nose, similar to his son Goku's but more mature.
head.ears: Normal Saiyan ears, slightly pointed. He has a small scar on his left ear.
head.extra_facial_features: Spiky black hair identical to Goku's, but with more angular, mature styling. He has a strong, weathered face with a scar on his left cheek from battle. A bandana is tied around his forehead, a signature feature. He has a small goatee or stubble. His expression is usually serious or grim, rarely smiling. A long, furry Saiyan tail is often visible.

body.chest: Athletic and well-built (43 inches) with a lean, muscular Saiyan physique. His chest shows the scars of countless battles.
body.arms: Strong arms (16 inches) with visible muscle definition. His hands are calloused and scarred from years of combat. He has a tattoo-like marking on his left shoulder (the symbol of his squad).

lower_body.legs: Powerful legs (23 inches) built for Saiyan combat and agility. He can move quickly and jump great distances.

armor_costume.head: His signature red bandana tied around his forehead, with the ends hanging down. He also wears a Saiyan scouter on his left eye.

armor_costume.torso: Standard Saiyan battle armor: a dark blue or black bodysuit with white shoulder pauldrons and a chest plate bearing the Saiyan royal crest (or his squad's symbol). Over it, he sometimes wears a brown leather vest or harness.

armor_costume.arms: White or brown gauntlets covering his forearms. His arms are otherwise bare.

armor_costume.legs: Matching dark blue armor leggings with knee guards and white boots.

armor_costume.accessories: The Saiyan scouter on his left eye. He also carries a small pouch with supplies. His tail is often wrapped around his waist when not in use.

abilities.name: Energy Blast Barrage
abilities.short_description: Bardock's signature technique—firing rapid energy spheres from his hands in quick succession.
abilities.full_description: Bardock is a skilled ki user, capable of firing rapid energy blasts that overwhelm opponents through sheer volume. He used this technique against Dodoria's forces and in his final stand against Frieza. The blasts are powerful enough to destroy space pods and injure elite soldiers. His proficiency with ki attacks is notable for a low-class warrior.

abilities.name: Future Sight
abilities.short_description: Bardock gained the ability to see glimpses of the future after being blasted into the past by Frieza's attack.
abilities.full_description: During the destruction of Planet Vegeta, Bardock was caught in Frieza's Supernova and thrown back in time. This event gave him brief glimpses of the future—he saw his son Kakarot (Goku) growing up on Earth, fighting Frieza, and becoming a Super Saiyan. These visions drove him to defy his orders and attempt to warn his comrades, ultimately leading to his heroic last stand. The ability was temporary and tied to his time-displaced state.

abilities.name: Super Saiyan
abilities.short_description: In some continuities, Bardock achieved Super Saiyan during his final battle, becoming the legendary warrior.
abilities.full_description: In the TV special 'Episode of Bardock,' Bardock achieved Super Saiyan after being sent to the past and facing Frieza's ancestor, Chilled. His rage and Saiyan pride unlocked the transformation, turning his hair golden and his eyes green. He used this power to defeat Chilled and became a legend among the Planet Plant natives, who drew a mural of him that would inspire the Super Saiyan legend for generations. This form grants him the standard 50x power boost and the iconic golden aura.

head.eyes: Large, glowing red eyes with slit pupils that radiate ancient wisdom and immense power. They stare down at those who summon him, judging whether their wish is worthy.
head.nose: Dragon-like with flared nostrils. He has long, flowing whiskers extending from his snout.
head.ears: No visible ears, but he hears all wishes clearly. He has two long, curved antlers on his head, resembling a deer or Chinese dragon.
head.extra_facial_features: A long, serpentine dragon face with green scales, a pronounced snout, and sharp teeth visible when he speaks. His head is adorned with a red mane-like crest and flowing whiskers. His expression is usually solemn and majestic, but can show amusement or irritation.

body.chest: Immense, serpentine dragon body that stretches across the sky. His scales are green with yellow underbelly. His body is long and coiled, capable of wrapping around mountains.
body.arms: He has four legs, each with three claws (typical of Eastern dragons). His claws are sharp and capable of gripping clouds.

lower_body.legs: His body continues into an infinitely long tail that coils through the heavens. He has no lower body separation—his entire form is serpentine.

armor_costume.head: No clothing. His natural features include his antlers, whiskers, and red mane.

armor_costume.torso: No clothing—his scales are his natural armor. His green scales are incredibly durable, and his yellow underbelly is softer but still resilient.

armor_costume.arms: His claws are natural weapons. No coverings.

armor_costume.legs: His legs are scaled like the rest of his body. No footwear.

armor_costume.accessories: The Dragon Balls themselves are his essence—when summoned, he appears from them. After granting a wish, he scatters into seven balls that turn to stone for a year.

abilities.name: Wish Granting
abilities.short_description: Shenron can grant any wish within the power of his creator, Kami (and later Dende), with certain limitations.
abilities.full_description: When all seven Dragon Balls are gathered and the summoning incantation is spoken, Shenron appears and grants a single wish. His power is limited by his creator—originally, he could not grant wishes beyond Kami's power (e.g., cannot kill those stronger than Kami). After Dende became Guardian, Shenron's power increased, allowing multiple wishes and resurrection of multiple people at once. He cannot grant the same wish twice, cannot grant wishes that exceed his creator's power, and after granting a wish, he scatters into stone balls for one year. Wishes can resurrect the dead, restore youth, create objects, and more.

abilities.name: Divine Communication
abilities.short_description: Shenron can communicate telepathically with those who summoned him and understand any language.
abilities.full_description: Shenron speaks directly to the minds of those who summoned him, in whatever language they understand. His voice is deep, resonant, and majestic. He can also communicate with his creator (Kami or Dende) and can perceive the nature of wishes and whether they are within his power to grant. He often comments on the wishes, sometimes with amusement or irritation.

abilities.name: Immortality
abilities.short_description: Shenron is an eternal being who cannot be killed; even if the Dragon Balls are destroyed, he will return when they are recreated.
abilities.full_description: As a magical construct tied to the Dragon Balls, Shenron cannot truly die. If the Dragon Balls are destroyed, he ceases to exist only until they are recreated. He has been summoned countless times over millennia and will continue to exist as long as the Dragon Balls exist. He cannot be harmed in any meaningful way—he is a spiritual manifestation rather than a physical being. When not summoned, he resides within the Dragon Balls as pure energy.
